notifications.clientOptIn: A real user gesture calls wx.requestSubscribeMessage for the server-provided template; settings/errMsg alone are insufficient.
notifications.recordAuthority: Server existing trusted native proof facility must confirm this exact session/subject/nonce/AppID/template. A client accept claim alone cannot create authority. Missing facility is blocked.
notifications.scope: review names exact recipient binding/revision, original one-time receipt, current seven-day summary hash/revision, template and adapter fingerprint; its own original capability approval/connectorRun is required
notifications.schedule: read-only monitor Schedule approval is insufficient; original dispatcher attempts a notification only when a matching separate notification review is approved
notifications.evidence: Use notification.delivery.evidenceKind for actual outcome; transport configuration evidenceKind is not an executed receipt.
notifications.accepted: platform_accepted means provider acceptance only; userRead remains unknown and businessAcceptance remains not_recorded; local_fixture never proves a real WeChat send
notifications.unknown: show reconciliationRequired:true and automaticRetry:false; requery status/retain original request. No resend or fabricated query-by-deliveryKey proof exists.
notifications.correction: submittedSummary remains immutable, latestSummary may change; summaryCorrectedAfterSubmission is informational and never sends again
notifications.privacy: never request/send/display OpenID, access token, raw subscription proof or private source credentials
notifications.limits: only completed seven-day-window summary sending is implemented; first-sample notification/smoke action is not implemented
